description: Auto Totem is a lightweight client-side utility mod that automatically moves a Totem of Undying into your off-hand when your health is critically low, and swaps it back when you recover. A simple keybind lets you enable or disable the feature on the fly.

mods.name: Auto Totem
mods.description: An essential utility mod that automatically swaps a Totem of Undying into your off-hand based on health or a customizable keybind.

releases.notes:
# AutoTotem 1.5.0

**Minecraft 26.3**

### Changelog

- Updated to **Minecraft 26.3** (Wilderness Bound)
- Updated Gradle to **9.6.0**
- Updated Fabric Loader to **0.19.5**
- Updated Fabric API to **0.160.7+26.3**
- Updated input handling for the new SDL-based input system
  - `InputConstants.Type.KEYBOARD`
  - `InputConstants.KEY_V`
- Updated status message to use `sendOverlayMessage`
- Confirmed compatibility with 26.3 Mojang mappings
- No changes to core auto-swap logic or health thresholds

### Notes
- Client-side only
- Requires Fabric API for 26.3
- Default toggle key remains **V** (configurable in Controls)
- Health thresholds unchanged: swap in at ≤ 2 hearts, swap back at > 5 hearts

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NotY215/AutoTotem/compare/1.4.0...1.5

### Update Summary

**Version 1.3 – Minecraft 26.1.2 Port**

- Fully updated to Minecraft **26.1.2** (unobfuscated / Mojang mappings)
- Switched to Java **25** and latest Fabric Loom / Fabric API
- Keybind (default **V**) now **toggles** the auto-swap feature on/off instead of performing a manual swap
- Clear action-bar status message when enabling or disabling
- Health-based swap logic preserved (≤ 2 hearts → swap in, > 5 hearts → swap back)
- License changed to **GPL-3.0**
- Updated README with badges and current information
